title: Fresh fixtures
summary: A fixture is prepared data used by a test. beforeEach can give each test a new fixture.
introduction: A fixture is prepared data used by a test. beforeEach can give each test a new fixture. We will use a small example so you can follow each step.
learningObjectives: Use the example to answer a practice question

blocks.title: Fresh fixtures

blocks.text: The list starts with one learner for each test.

items: Read the example from top to bottom. Point to the part that uses the new idea.
Add a test that pushes Ben and checks length 2.
Explain what changed in your own words. Check the example again if you get stuck.

blocks.title: A common mistake
blocks.text: Sharing changed fixture data can make test order matter.
For more detail later, use this [Vitest further reading](https://vitest.dev/guide/).
